title: 9. Powers and Functions of Chief Minister

blocks.content:
• Head of Council of Ministers
• Advises Governor on appointment and removal of ministers
• Allocates portfolios
• Leader of the State Legislature
• Coordinates policies of departments
• Chief spokesperson of State Government
Advises Governor on appointment and removal of ministers

items: The Governor appoints or removes ministers only on the advice of the Chief Minister.
Portfolio allocation among ministers is the exclusive power of the Chief Minister.
The Chief Minister, not the Governor, serves as the chief spokesperson of the State Government.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Serves as the head of the State Council of Ministers.
Advises the Governor on the appointment and removal of ministers.
Allocates and reshuffles various portfolios among state ministers.
Acts as the leader of the State Legislature and chief spokesperson of the State Government.
Coordinates policies across different executive departments.
